name: Tambaqui (Colossoma macropomum)
description: Tambaqui (Colossoma macropomum), tracked as its own compartment by the source. One of the Amazon's most important food fishes, migrating into the flooded forest to gorge on fruits and seeds - about four-fifths of its diet in this web comes from the floodplain forest. Heavy fishing pressure makes it a focus of the study's deforestation-and-fishing scenarios.
